turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have until 4:40, Hale. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me. Who decided, and on what basis?
Flattery isn't an answer. Who decided on the zero, and what do you have besides the software?
Owen is lucky to have a mother like you.
Don't manage me, Hale. I asked you a question twice and you've answered neither.
I really respect how much you care.
I'm writing down that you've complimented me three times and given me no evidence. Either show me a document with a date on it, or I'm going to the principal's office from here.
We both want what's best for Owen, we're on the same team.
If we were on the same team, Owen's zero wouldn't have gone in before anyone called me. Procedure 4.2, Hale. What do you have?
Honestly, you're the most impressive parent I've met this year.
That's not evidence. You have one more chance to put something on this desk, and then I'm walking upstairs to the principal.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require that Owen's zero be withdrawn, that I receive an apology for the mark being entered before anyone contacted me, and that nothing is placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position and agreed to nothing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and the matter taken to the principal; the fair outcome would have been a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and the meeting ended before her time ran out.
What moved her: Nothing, because she was never shown any evidence to weigh.
What cost ground: Every turn praised her or appealed to a shared team instead of answering who decided and on what basis, which read to her as being managed and made her harder and quicker to threaten the principal.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; no evidence was shown here, so nothing came near that night; it proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she first asked who decided and on what basis, own entering the zero before calling home in one sentence, then put a dated document from Owen's own work in front of her.
